cards.ex: She's a world-class athlete; her dedication is unmatched.
cards.exUz: U jahon darajasidagi sportchi; uning fidoyiligi tengsiz.
cards.uzDef: Eng yuqori darajadagi, dunyo bo'ylab tan olingan sportchi.

cards.ex: The match was a walkover; their opponents barely put up a fight.
cards.exUz: O'yin oson g'alaba bo'ldi; ularning raqiblari deyarli qarshilik ko'rsatmadi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlik bilan erishilgan g'alaba, raqobat yo'q.

cards.ex: Several companies are still in the running for the contract.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta kompaniyalar hali ham shartnoma uchun imkoniyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoniyati bor.

cards.ex: He's considered a frontrunner in the mayoral election.
cards.exUz: U mer saylovida peshqadam deb hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Musobaqada yoki tanlovda oldinda borayotgan ishtirokchi.

cards.ex: She's currently the front runner in the polls.
cards.exUz: Hozirda u so'rovnomalarda asosiy nomzod.
cards.uzDef: Musobaqada yoki tanlovda g'alaba qozonish uchun eng katta imkoniyatga ega bo'lgan shaxs.

cards.ex: She's really on top of the game when it comes to marketing.
cards.exUz: U marketingga kelganda haqiqatan ham ustunlik qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Ishni yaxshi bilmoq, vaziyatni nazorat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Replacing him will be a tough act to follow.
cards.exUz: Uning o'rnini bosish qiyin vazifa bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: O'rnini bosish qiyin bo'lgan shaxs yoki vazifa.

cards.ex: We need to innovate to stay ahead of the competition.
cards.exUz: Raqobatdan oldinda bo'lish uchun biz innovatsiya qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan oldinda bo'lish, ustunlikni saqlab qolish.

cards.ex: They managed to get the upper hand in the negotiations.
cards.exUz: Ular muzokaralarda ustunlikka erishishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan ustun kelish, afzallikka ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Our team completely trounced the opposition, winning by a landslide.
cards.exUz: Bizning jamoa raqibni butunlay mag'lub etdi, juda katta farq bilan g'alaba qozondi.
cards.uzDef: Raqibni juda katta farq bilan yutmoq, ularni tor-mor qilmoq.

cards.ex: The two runners were neck-and-neck for most of the race.
cards.exUz: Ikki yuguruvchi poyganing ko'p qismida yonma-yon kelishdi.
cards.uzDef: Tengma-teng, bir xil natija ko'rsatib borayotgan.

cards.ex: She attributed her team's victory to peak performance from all the players.
cards.exUz: U jamoasining g'alabasini barcha o'yinchilarning eng yuqori natijasi bilan izohladi.
cards.uzDef: Sportchining eng yaxshi, maksimal natija ko'rsatishi.

cards.ex: Even with his injury, he felt he still had a sporting chance to win the race.
cards.exUz: Jarohati bo'lishiga qaramay, u poygada g'alaba qozonish uchun imkoniyati bor deb hisobladi.
cards.uzDef: Ozgina bo'lsa ham, muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: It was their grit and determination that ultimately led them to victory.
cards.exUz: Ularning qat'iyati va irodasi ularni oxir-oqibat g'alabaga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, o'z maqsadiga erishish uchun qat'iyat va iroda.

cards.ex: His experience gave him a competitive edge over the other candidates.
cards.exUz: Uning tajribasi unga boshqa nomzodlarga nisbatan ustunlik berdi.
cards.uzDef: Raqobatda boshqalardan ustun bo'lishga imkon beradigan afzallik.

cards.ex: They won the match fair and square, with no arguments about the referee's decisions.
cards.exUz: Ular uchrashuvda halol g'alaba qozonishdi, hakam qarorlari haqida hech qanday bahs bo'lmadi.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli qoidalar asosida, hech qanday hiyla ishlatmasdan.

cards.ex: The basketball player was totally in the zone, sinking every shot.
cards.exUz: Basketbolchi to'liq diqqat markazida edi, har bir to'pni savatga tashladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z ishiga to'liq diqqatini jamlagan va unumli holatda.

cards.ex: Negotiations between the teams ground to a halt after the disagreement.
cards.exUz: Jamoalar o'rtasidagi muzokaralar kelishmovchilikdan so'ng to'xtab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Jarayon asta-sekin sekinlashib, keyin butunlay to'xtash.

cards.ex: The defeat was a wake-up call for the team, forcing them to re-evaluate their strategy.
cards.exUz: Mag'lubiyat jamoa uchun ogohlantiruv bo'ldi, ularni o'z strategiyalarini qayta ko'rib chiqishga majbur qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan voqea, xato yoki muammo haqida ogohlantiruvchi signal.

cards.ex: Instead of complaining, she decided to take the bull by the horns and solve the problem herself.
cards.exUz: Shikoyat qilish o'rniga, u tavakkal qilib, muammoni o'zi hal qilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda faol harakat qilish, muammoni dadil hal qilish.

cards.ex: The negotiations became a war of attrition, with each side waiting for the other to give in.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar charchash urushiga aylandi, har bir tomon boshqasining taslim bo'lishini kutardi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq davom etadigan va resurslarni tugatadigan raqobat.

cards.ex: The CEO threw down the gauntlet to his competitors, promising to double sales within a year.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor raqobatchilariga chaqiriq tashladi va bir yil ichida savdoni ikki baravar oshirishga va'da berdi.
cards.uzDef: Raqibga ochiqchasiga qarshi chiqish, bellashuvga chaqirish.

cards.ex: To succeed in this industry, you need to stay ahead of the curve and constantly innovate.
cards.exUz: Bu sohada muvaffaqiyat qozonish uchun siz zamondan ilg'or bo'lishingiz va doimo yangilik yaratishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oxirgi tendentsiyalardan xabardor bo'lish, raqobatda oldinda bo'lish.

cards.ex: He started as an intern and rose through the ranks to become a senior manager.
cards.exUz: U stajyor sifatida ish boshladi va bosqichma-bosqich yuqori menejer lavozimiga ko'tarildi.
cards.uzDef: Past lavozimdan boshlab, bosqichma-bosqich yuqori lavozimlarga ko'tarilish.

cards.ex: The team decided to play it safe and not take any unnecessary risks in the final minutes.
cards.exUz: Jamoa ehtiyot bo'lishga va so'nggi daqiqalarda keraksiz xavflarni olmaslikka qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni minimallashtirish uchun konservativ yondashuvni tanlash.

cards.ex: With their recent victories, they've proven they are a real contender for the championship.
cards.exUz: So'nggi g'alabalari bilan ular chempionat uchun asosiy da'vogar ekanliklarini isbotladilar.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish uchun jiddiy imkoniyatga ega bo'lgan shaxs yoki jamoa.

cards.ex: The young gymnast stole the show with her incredible routine.
cards.exUz: Yosh gimnastikachi o'zining ajoyib chiqishi bilan diqqatni tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq diqqat va olqishlarga sazovor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The veteran player made a remarkable comeback after his injury.
cards.exUz: Tajribali o'yinchi jarohatidan so'ng ajoyib tarzda qaytdi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq tanaffusdan so'ng yana muvaffaqiyatli faoliyatni boshlash.

cards.ex: The game had a nail-biting finish, with the winning goal scored in the last second.
cards.exUz: O'yinning hayajonli yakuni bo'ldi, g'alaba goli so'nggi soniyada urildi.
cards.uzDef: Oxirigacha g'olib noma'lum bo'lgan juda hayajonli yakun.

cards.ex: The election was a one-horse race; everyone knew who was going to win.
cards.exUz: Saylov oson g'alaba edi; hamma kim g'alaba qozonishini bilardi.
cards.uzDef: Yagona da'vogar borligi sababli, g'alabasi oldindan ma'lum bo'lgan poyga.
